title: MyTrainX Start — 4 Weeks
goal: Build training consistency, movement confidence and a sustainable full-body resistance-training habit.
description: Four-week guided onboarding program using canonical MyTrainX exercise families and Coach X review rules.

stages.title: Week 0 — Onboarding
stages.completion_rule: Complete readiness, tracking and equipment setup.

stages.title: Week 1 — Learn the patterns
stages.completion_rule: Complete sessions 1A, 1B and 1C or their minimum versions.

stages.title: Week 2 — Repeat before adding
stages.completion_rule: Repeat A/B/C and progress at most one variable per selected movement.

stages.title: Week 3 — Build a little more work
stages.completion_rule: Add volume only where adherence and recovery support it.

stages.title: Week 4 — Consolidate
stages.completion_rule: Complete the final three sessions and Coach X review.
